relationship_to_earlier_release: Independent study; not the protocol or output set of the earlier release main table.
model_selection: Save only when validation loss improves by more than min_delta; apply configured early-stopping guards. A saved checkpoint need not be the strict numerical minimum.

warmup.vq_and_ar: lr_set*u/1001 for u=1..1000; warmup updates are included in the total update budget.
warmup.dfm: lr_set*u/501 for u=1..500; warmup updates are included in the total update budget.

first_stage_training.normalization: Per-coordinate z-score from eligible TRAIN sequences only.
first_stage_training.short_sequences_in_final_evaluation: Retained, using the documented minimum-length padding when required.

second_stage_training.cap_selection: TRAIN length 99.5th percentile rounded up to a multiple of 64, giving 320 for both datasets.
second_stage_training.early_stop_guard: Maximum of configured minimum and last learning-rate milestone plus 1000; patience counter is halved after an LR reduction.

reconstruction.velocity_unit: dataset coordinate unit per native frame step

generation.eos: Allowed only after a complete nonempty token group.
generation.training_truncation: Prefix of at most 320 pose frames; EOS supervision masked when the source continues beyond this prefix.

evaluation.scale: BLEU/chrF/ROUGE-L percentage-scale scores; WER percent and may exceed 100.
evaluation.evaluator_weights: Fixed supplied pretrained evaluator checkpoints; not included.

postprocessing.target_length: Equal-sample TRAIN mean segment length from the corresponding dataset.
postprocessing.directions: Preserve directions from the pre-projection snapshot.
postprocessing.palm_vectors: Preserve ten complete wrist-to-palm vectors from the processing input.
postprocessing.degenerate_direction: Nearest valid frame in the same sequence, past frame on ties, then corresponding training reference direction; epsilon=1e-8.
postprocessing.interpretation: Near-zero projected CV is constructive, not independent evidence of perceptual or semantic quality.

validation.ce_aggregation: preserve original batch CE weighted by batch sample count

sampling.end_condition: fixed text-predicted complete-group length, no EOS
sampling.update_rule: Already revealed tokens stay fixed; masked positions reveal with probability t_next; no remasking.
